title: Ottoman building style
blurb: Ottoman towns at the outbreak of war, from Edirne to Gallipoli and the Levant: stone ground floors, projecting timber upper storeys with lattice windows, low tile roofs, lead domes, minarets and street fountains. Nothing carries script.
